sanskrit: evam āvedayām āsur munayas te mamānagha ye te bhāgīrathītīre mayā dṛṣṭā yudhiṣṭhira
english: Thus did the sages report to me, O sinless one—those whom I beheld upon the bank of the Bhāgīrathī, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: evaṃ svenāgninā rājā samāyukto mahīpate mā śocithās tvaṃ nṛpatiṃ gataḥ sa paramāṃ gatim
english: Thus, O lord of the earth, the king was united with his own sacred fire. Do not grieve: that monarch has gone to the highest goal.

sanskrit: guruśuśrūṣayā caiva jananī tava pāṇḍava prāptā sumahatīṃ siddhim iti me nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: And through her devoted service to her elders, your mother too, O son of Pāṇḍu, has attained a most exalted perfection—of this I have no doubt.

sanskrit: kartum arhasi kauravya teṣāṃ tvam udakakriyām bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvair etad atra vidhīyatām
english: It is fitting, O scion of Kuru, that you perform the water-rites for them, together with all your brothers; let this now be ordained here.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ dhuraṃdharaḥ niryayau saha sodaryaiḥ sadāro bharatarṣabha
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then that guardian of the earth, the foremost bearer of the Pāṇḍavas' burden, set forth together with his brothers and his wife, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: paurajānapadāś caiva rājabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ gaṅgāṃ prajagmur abhito vāsasaikena saṃvṛtāḥ
english: And the city-folk and the country-folk, moved foremost by their devotion to the king, went down all around to the Gaṅgā, each clad in a single garment.

sanskrit: tato 'vagāhya salilaṃ sarve te kurupuṃgavāḥ yuyutsum agrataḥ kṛtvā dadus toyaṃ mahātmane
english: Then, plunging into the water, all those bulls among the Kurus, with Yuyutsu placed at their head, offered the libation to the great-souled one.

sanskrit: gāndhāryāś ca pṛthāyāś ca vidhivan nāmagotrataḥ śaucaṃ nivartayantas te tatroṣur nagarād bahiḥ
english: And for Gāndhārī and for Pṛthā, duly by name and lineage, they performed the rites; and completing the period of mourning, they dwelt there outside the city.

sanskrit: preṣayām āsa sa narān vidhijñān āptakāriṇaḥ gaṅgādvāraṃ kuruśreṣṭho yatra dagdho 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: That best of the Kurus dispatched men who knew the rites and were faithful in their duties to Gaṅgādvāra, the place where the king had been consumed by fire.

sanskrit: tatraiva teṣāṃ kulyāni gaṅgādvāre 'nvaśāt tadā kartavyānīti puruṣān dattadeyān mahīpatiḥ
english: There at Gaṅgādvāra the lord of the earth then instructed those men, on whom gifts had been bestowed, that the funerary water-offerings for them were to be performed.

sanskrit: dvādaśe 'hani tebhyaḥ sa kṛtaśauco narādhipaḥ dadau śrāddhāni vidhivad dakṣiṇāvanti pāṇḍavaḥ
english: On the twelfth day, his mourning ended, that ruler of men, the son of Pāṇḍu, duly offered for them the śrāddha rites, attended with sacrificial fees.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ samuddiśya dadau sa pṛthivīpatiḥ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ gāś ca śayyāś ca sumahādhanāḥ
english: Designating the offering for Dhṛtarāṣṭra, that lord of the earth gave gold, silver, cattle, and couches of very great worth.

sanskrit: gāndhāryāś caiva tejasvī pṛthāyāś ca pṛthak pṛthak saṃkīrtya nāmanī rājā dadau dānam anuttamam
english: And for Gāndhārī and for Pṛthā, each in turn, the splendid king, proclaiming their names, bestowed gifts beyond compare.

sanskrit: yo yad icchati yāvac ca tāvat sa labhate dvijaḥ śayanaṃ bhojanaṃ yānaṃ maṇiratnam atho dhanam
english: Whatever a brahmin desired, and however much, that much he received—bedding, food, a carriage, jewels and gems, and wealth besides.

sanskrit: yānam ācchādanaṃ bhogān dāsīś ca paricārikāḥ dadau rājā samuddiśya tayor mātror mahīpatiḥ
english: Carriages, garments, comforts, and serving-maids as attendants—all these the king, that lord of the earth, gave, designating the offerings for those two mothers.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālo dattvā śrāddhāny anekaśaḥ praviveśa punar dhīmān nagaraṃ vāraṇāhvayam
english: Then that guardian of the earth, having offered the śrāddha rites many times over, the wise one entered once more the city called after the elephant.

sanskrit: te cāpi rājavacanāt puruṣā ye gatābhavan saṃkalpya teṣāṃ kulyāni punaḥ pratyāgamaṃs tataḥ
english: And those men who had gone forth at the king's command, having duly performed the water-offerings for them, came back again from there.

sanskrit: mālyair gandhaiś ca vividhaiḥ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi kulyāni teṣāṃ saṃyojya tadācakhyur mahīpateḥ
english: Having honored them according to rule with garlands and divers perfumes, and having duly performed the water-rites for them, they then reported it to the lord of the earth.

sanskrit: samāśvāsya ca rājānaṃ dharmātmānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram nārado 'py agamad rājan paramarṣir yathepsitam
english: And having consoled the king, the righteous-souled Yudhiṣṭhira, Nārada too, that supreme sage, departed, O king, as he wished.

sanskrit: evaṃ varṣāṇy atītāni dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dhīmataḥ vanavāse tadā trīṇi nagare daśa pañca ca
english: Thus passed the years of the wise Dhṛtarāṣṭra—three then in dwelling in the forest, and fifteen within the city.

sanskrit: hataputrasya saṃgrāme dānāni dadataḥ sadā jñātisaṃbandhimitrāṇāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ svajanasya ca
english: His sons slain in battle, he ever bestowed gifts in memory of his kinsmen, his relations by marriage, his friends, his brothers, and his own people.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiras tu nṛpatir nātiprītamanās tadā dhārayām āsa tad rājyaṃ nihatajñātibāndhavaḥ
english: But King Yudhiṣṭhira, his heart far from glad, his kinsmen and relatives slain, upheld that kingdom even then.
